prompts.prompt: Implement a C++20 bounded thread-safe queue supporting move-only elements. Provide push, blocking pop, try_pop, and close. Close must wake all blocked threads, allow draining existing items, and reject future pushes. Handle spurious wakeups and exceptions without deadlocks. Explain one subtle race after the implementation. Start directly with code, using only the standard library.
